                                   Resolution 2022-22

                    Of the Girdwood Board of Supervisors
                        RESOLUTION OF SUPPORT
                              FOR
                 SOA TRAFFIC SPEED AND VOLUME STUDY

WHEREAS, Girdwood is a pedestrian-friendly community, in which many adults and children access neighborhood amenities on foot
regardless of weather, daylight and road conditions; and

WHEREAS, Girdwood’s streets offer a variety of challenges to drivers and pedestrians, including foliage and snowbanks, steep
slopes; and generally narrow roadbeds without sidewalks; and

WHEREAS, the volume and speed of vehicle traffic has increased to the point that it is necessary to have traffic calming measures to
reduce speeding in the residential neighborhoods;

THEREFORE, to promote a safer community, the Girdwood Board of Supervisors requests that the State of Alaska, Department of
Transportation conduct a Speed and Volume study on the following roads during the summer season;
    •   Mount Hood portion maintained by State of Alaska Dept of Transportation


PASSED AND APPROVED by a vote of 5 to 0 this 17th day of October, 2022.





                                                       October 17, 2022

Jennifer Wingard                                       Date
